notes:
• Supabase Multi-Tenant Database Migration: Fully migrated to high-availability isolated Supabase backend.
• Tenant Held Orders Isolation: Completely isolated held orders per tenant with zero cross-tenant visibility.
• Ultra-Persistent Held Orders: Held orders are guaranteed to persist safely across power cuts and restarts until checkout.
• Alphabetical UI Sorting: Categories, products, deals, raw materials, and customers sorted alphabetically (A-Z).
• Dine-In Table Status Display: Table numbers visible in orders list badges and order detail modal.
• Timestamp Preservation: Original order creation time permanently preserved across holds and subsequent edits.
• Duplicate Order Prevention: Anti-duplication guards prevent accidental double orders and payment submissions.
• Advanced Reports & Profit Analysis: Full PNG preview before local download with raw material cost and profit calculation.
